master_style: Premium child-friendly "complete the drawing" activity artwork for a mobile kids creative app. Clean modern cartoon illustration, bright harmonious colors, simple rounded shapes, thick polished outlines, clear silhouette, minimal background, centered composition, easy for a child to understand and finish. The completed side must be fully colored and polished, while the missing side or missing part must use very light gray dashed construction guides only, clearly separated from the finished artwork. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no buttons, no watermark, no logo, no frame, no photorealism. The background must be plain pure white (#FFFFFF), uniform and identical across the entire square, with no cream tint, no warm tint, no gradient, no vignette and no panel or half of the image shaded differently from the rest. Square 1:1 composition, PNG/JPG ready.
